why: Subsets with pruning: each word is included or excluded, and a branch is cut as soon as adding a word would repeat a character. A 26-bit mask per word makes the 'no overlap' test one AND.
hints: With at most 16 words there are 2^16 subsets. What is the cheapest way to test that two words share no character?
Turn each word into a bitmask; drop words that repeat a letter internally. dfs(i, mask): skip word i, or take it if (mask & m[i]) == 0.
Track the best popcount of mask over all leaves. Pruning on overlap keeps the search well below 2^16.
pitfalls: A word like 'aa' can never be used.
